pages.text: A drink earns up to five stars: one to start, then one each for $(item)cultured yeast$(), the $(item)right temperature$(), its $(item)craft step$() and $(item)aging$(). Hold Shift over a drink to see which it earned.

The craft step: a day's rest in a cask or keg for beer and wine; a second run through the still for spirits. Aging: years in a cask of the right wood.$(br2)Better stars mean longer effects and gentler hangovers.
